review.provenance: EB primary reading and author-code review; this addendum checks our host and does not claim a new independent reading of those papers.

actual_action_space.connectivity: Automatic creation at actual distance <=1.15 with living endpoints; automatic break at distance >1.65 or endpoint death. No policy action chooses form/hold/release.
actual_action_space.new_contact: rest, theta and reference start at actual contact distance; baseline/accumulator/count/perturbation reset on new contact.
actual_action_space.plastic_action: Bounded rest-length proposal theta + 0.08*perturbation, range [0.6,1.4]; theta range [0.65,1.35]. Simultaneous proposals require payment at both endpoints.
actual_action_space.transport: Lagrangian moving material-node identities, not Eulerian CA K transport; position, mass and energy evolve, no birth. Do not describe this host as Lenia or as the old raster transport interface.

existing_controls.plastic: Standard local perturbation rule using completed average endpoint uptake relative to EMA, not a new algorithm.
existing_controls.plastic_sign: Sign of that advantage multiplied by registered perturbation; not a selected-action Q table and not alpha=1 recent-action learning.
existing_controls.fixed_readout: Fixed reference-length spring plus same-information, same-range online force compensation; full trajectory agreement already measured to 8.881784197001252e-16.
existing_controls.passive: Rest-length relaxation without consequence feedback; maintained as passive-history comparison.

feedback_boundary.actual_R: Mean of actual uptake at the two endpoints over the registered interval. Coupled motions and neighbor actions affect it.
feedback_boundary.credit: Descriptive local outcome, not an isolated edge causal effect. The learning R is uptake, not net energy after allocating per-edge total costs.
feedback_boundary.unknown: No completed samples means no content update; absent observations are not negative reward. The rule is not audited here as selected-executed-action Q learning.
feedback_boundary.pricing: Positive modeled spring-energy change plus remodeling proxy paid, release recorded, movement/basal charged. External work and complete mechanical dissipation are not closed; no thermodynamic saving claim.

future_strong_null_if_action_space_chang.rule: Q_e(a) <- Q_e(a) + alpha*(R_e-Q_e(a)), alpha=1 as a strong recent-outcome baseline, only for registered and actually executed edge action with completed feedback.
future_strong_null_if_action_space_chang.fairness: Same real contact eligibility, form/hold versus release/not-form actions, l0 actions if any, local receipts, exploration, state budget, contact lifetime, transport and payment rules. Missing stays unknown.
future_strong_null_if_action_space_chang.restriction: Do not give persistent load-bearing ability only to candidate, and do not add imaginary form/release control to a retrospective comparison.

interpretation: Main plastic trajectories retained the initial 22 contacts without newly formed topology: evidence concerns reference-length remodeling, not learned path construction.
A limited consequence-dependent content effect is compatible with standard local plasticity. Existing full-force compensation already closes extra representational advantage.
An unrun edge-Q baseline is a scope limitation, not a reason to rescue the closed candidate or extend its matrix.
Breaking a bond changes mechanics and cannot by itself establish memory-specific erasure.
The previously submitted scientific choice remains unchanged; no repeated event or completion broadcast is required.

nearest_work_from_EB.bearing: Local unstressed connection formation and multiple mechanical memories already exist.

nearest_work_from_EB.locations: III-V Eqs4-8; VII Figs6-7/AppendixF; VIII Fig8
nearest_work_from_EB.bearing: Local motor memory affecting rest length/stiffness already exists; VIII includes length negative feedback, so do not characterize the whole work as requiring external supervision. Published 2026 version is distinct from 2025 preprint.
